title: Automated Communication Pipeline
description: One trigger, two very different-feeling messages: see what decides whether a rule sends a text or queues a newsletter item.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Analyzing Club Data and Choosing the Right Tools

educational.audience: Club leaders setting up automated communications

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a trigger condition, the learner differentiates whether it should route through SMS notification or newsletter automation.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin pipeline with an urgency gate and two converging delivery paths
pedagogical.assessment: Give three triggers and ask which path each takes.
